issues.description: Indentation bug: the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` block sits flush-left right after `Math_unary`'s `cases` list, dropping the blank-line separator and risking confusion about scope.
issues.detail: The patch removes the blank line between the class body and the next top-level statement, then attaches the version-gated registration immediately. The data here is simple: a class plus a registration call. Keep them visually separated, and consider listing `math.exp2` alongside the other `@infer_global` decorators rather than reassigning the class name through a guarded one-liner.

issues.description: Version gate is the wrong data structure; CPython adds `math.exp2` based on libc/runtime, not Python version.
issues.detail: Guarding with `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)` is a proxy. The real data is `hasattr(math, 'exp2')`. Using the attribute check makes the algorithm self-evident and survives backports, vendored builds, and future renames. Three call sites repeat the same proxy condition; centralize it or use the direct attribute test.

Both files now reference `sys.version_info` but the diff only adds `import sys` to `mathdecl.py`. Unless `sys` is already imported in those modules (not shown in the diff), this will NameError at import time. Verify and add the import where needed.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline and has a redundant sentence.
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends without a newline (`\ No newline at end of file`) and the body just restates the title. Two lines do the work of four. Add the newline; trim the body or drop it.

issues.description: Test reuses `exp`'s x_values verbatim; the data could exercise exp2's distinct shape.
issues.detail: `exp2` is `2**x`, not `e**x`. Reusing `[-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is fine for smoke coverage but adds nothing exp-specific. A couple of integer powers (e.g. 10, 0, -53) would catch precision and overflow differences cheaply. Small change, better signal.

issues.description: Two parallel `mathimpl.py` files duplicate the same gated registration; the duplication is the smell.
issues.detail: `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` register the same intrinsic with the same gate. Not this PR's job to unify, but worth noting: each new math function pays this tax twice. A shared registration list (data, not code) would make additions one-line.

review.summary: Small, focused PR wiring `math.exp2` through typing, two impl modules, docs, and a test. Two real concerns: (1) the version-info gate is a proxy for the actual data — whether `math.exp2` exists — and `hasattr(math, 'exp2')` would be the obvious check; (2) the impl files use `sys.version_info` but the diff only shows `import sys` added to `mathdecl.py`, so the other two need verifying. Indentation/blank-line hygiene around the new `if` block in `mathdecl.py` is sloppy. Release note has no trailing newline and is redundant. The shape is right — small additions following an existing pattern — but the duplicated gate across three sites hints the underlying registration could be data rather than three repeated branches. SMALL-AND-COMPOSABLE overall, WRONG-DATA-STRUCTURE on the version check.
